smart_test.description: Smart test suite — 21 tests covering every routing path + wizard + memory. T1-T13 are routing/correctness tests; T14-T17 cover the LLM-driven nf-core wizard; T18-T21 cover chat memory recall at varying distances. T1-T13 run in fresh sessions; T14-T21 use multi-turn shared sessions (session_mode='shared') with per-turn pass_criteria.

pass_criterion_ops.contains: value is in list (if actual is list) or substring (if actual is string)
pass_criterion_ops.nonempty: field is truthy / non-empty (value is ignored)
pass_criterion_ops.true: field is exactly True (value is ignored)
pass_criterion_ops.mentions: case-insensitive substring of `value` appears in the string `actual` (use with last_reply, wizard.* string fields)

session_modes.fresh: default; new SQLiteSessionState per test, results don't persist across tests
session_modes.shared: single session for all turns of this test; chat_log + results_history + wizard state accumulate

multi_turn_shape.turns: list[{label, query, pass_criteria, planner_pass_criteria}] — when present, replaces the legacy {setup_queries, query} pair. Each entry runs in order against the same session. Per-turn pass_criteria are evaluated independently; the test passes only if all turns pass.

special_fields_run_query.entity_projects: list of project strings from debug.entity_result.projects
special_fields_run_query.wizard.metadata_summary_present: bool — True if pinned_context.metadata_summary is set
special_fields_run_query.wizard_agent.last_extracted_keys: list[str] — keys from most recent WizardAgentOutput.extracted
special_fields_run_query.chat_log.latest_bundle_id: int|null — bundle_id on the most recent turn
special_fields_run_query.last_reply: str — final assistant reply for this turn (HTML stripped)
special_fields_run_query.last_target_result_id: int|null — parser_plan.target_result_id from the most recent turn

special_fields_run_query_plan.plan_entity_projects: list of project strings from debug.entity.projects
special_fields_run_query_plan.plan_step1_api_plan.*: alias prefix: debug.step_results[1].api_plan — navigate remainder with dot

coverage_map_by_subagent.report_writer_agent: T8, T9, T10 (saved_files manifest). NOT called for NFCORE post-fix; T17 verifies the bypass by checking emission succeeds without an LLMFatalError.
coverage_map_by_subagent.chatter_agent_answer: T15/T16 explicitly assert last_reply via 'mentions'/'matches_re'; every other test exercises it implicitly.
coverage_map_by_subagent.memory_coder_agent: T20 specifically validates correctness (not just routing). T18/T19/T21 exercise it implicitly.
coverage_map_by_subagent.wizard_agent: T14, T15, T16, T17 (T21 also exercises bundle-skip)
coverage_map_by_subagent.seqera_agent + seqera/emitter: exercised by T17 when TOWER_* env is set
